368244.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Two clearly different photos on your computer (e.g. a red square and a blue square).
  • One technician [Tech-A] at this location (Role Technician, Departments = Service, Time Clock on) who can sign in with her own email and password. Name is an example ("Esther Howard").
  • [Tech-A] leads at least one work order at this location (for her Board View column).

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = Service (only technicians in the Service department show as rows on the Schedule) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard"). Give her an email you can open; she accepts the invitation and sets a password.
  2. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Photo Board" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  3. Work Orders > Create Work Order > New Work Order: Customer = "ZZAUTOTEST Photo Board" > Asset = its asset > Save. If a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open. Record the number shown at the top left as [WO-1].
  4. In New Line > What Are You Doing? type "grease" and pick the ready-made line "Service - Full grease service" (it has no parts) > turn Line Approved on > Save & Close.
  5. On [WO-1], on the status card at the left, click Lead Technician and pick [Tech-A]. (Lead Technician is a dropdown only once the work order is Approved; while it is an Estimate it reads "Unassigned" and cannot be changed.) The choice saves at once.
  6. As [Tech-A], upload the red photo (the person signs in, clicks their initials at the top right > Edit Profile, clicks "Click to upload a profile photo" and picks the file; the picture shows at once).
  7. Check the setup worked: as [Tech-A], the top bar shows the red photo.
368244.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, pick Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View") and look at the avatar in [Tech-A]'s column header (scroll right to her column if needed).
  2. Upload the blue photo as [Tech-A]'s photo (the person signs in, clicks their initials at the top right > Edit Profile, clicks "Click to upload a profile photo" and picks the file; the picture shows at once).
  3. Go back to the same place and reload the page.
  4. Look at the avatar again.
368244.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the upload the avatar shows the red photo.
  • After the reload it shows the blue photo, not the old red one.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 9; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §9, hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 9: “Avatars everywhere (header, Staff, Schedule, cards). Avatars are now cached. After someone uploads a new photo, a reload must show the new one.”
  • QA handoff §9: “After a new photo is uploaded, a reload shows the new image.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

368191.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Schedule access: the Admin role has Schedule > View and Create & Edit (Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • A work order [WO-1] at this location has a line whose labor was logged by a staff member who has since been deleted, so its Labor row reads "Deleted user".
  • One technician [Tech-J] in the Service department (example "Jenny Wilson").

Setup

  1. Find such a line: open work orders you know were worked by former staff and check their Lines tab. If there is none on this site, mark the case Blocked with "no Deleted user line on this site".
  2. Click Schedule in the top menu > click the > arrow next to Today once so the date reads tomorrow. In Search work orders (left) type [WO-1]. Drag its card onto [Tech-J]'s row (scroll the rows down to find it) and drop it under 10 AM. In the window that opens click Choose lines, tick only "that line", use − / + until Hours reads 2h and click the Create button (it reads "Create 1 shift" or "Create shift · 1 line · …").
  3. Check the setup worked: tomorrow [Tech-J]'s row shows the shift on that line.
368191.custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] and click the Lines tab.
  2. Read that line's Labor row.
368191.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Labor row still reads "Deleted user". The scheduled technician does not replace a line that has real labor.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §8; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (S7-R8). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §8: “A line with real labor keeps its labor technician, and "Deleted user" stays.”
  • PRD S7-R8: “On the work order’s Lines tab, a line with no labor technician but with technicians scheduled on it from the Schedule shows those technicians’ names in its Labor row, in place of “Unassigned”.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
